songs.name: Paper Lantern
songs.description: A small light guides a walk home, building from intimacy to resolve.

arrangements.VOCAL: A sustained melodic line rises into a clear final refrain.
arrangements.RAP: Measured narrative bars open into a rhythmic refrain.
arrangements.DANCE: Compact gestures expand into traveling steps and a held finish.

songs.name: Bright Platform
songs.description: A departure platform becomes the setting for an independent beginning.

arrangements.VOCAL: An even verse leads into an open ascending hook.
arrangements.RAP: Precise syncopated verses resolve in a repeated response.
arrangements.DANCE: Directional footwork traces a departure and decisive return.

songs.name: Blueprint Heart
songs.description: Careful plans give way to an honest personal statement.

arrangements.VOCAL: Controlled phrases contrast with a warmer chorus.
arrangements.RAP: Clipped opening bars loosen into a flowing central section.
arrangements.DANCE: Geometric isolations soften into continuous movement.

songs.name: After the Rain
songs.description: An empty street brightens as its traveler finds a fresh rhythm.

arrangements.VOCAL: Gentle entrances grow into a resilient melodic refrain.
arrangements.RAP: Spacious storytelling develops into a buoyant rhythmic hook.
arrangements.DANCE: Grounded opening steps develop into buoyant traveling phrases.

songs.name: Signal Window
songs.description: A distant window answers a signal sent across the evening.

arrangements.VOCAL: Call-and-response phrases are performed as one expressive solo.
arrangements.RAP: Alternating rhythmic motifs create the question and answer.
arrangements.DANCE: Reaching motifs contrast with sharp answering accents.

songs.name: Small Orbit
songs.description: Familiar routines become a confident journey beyond the usual circle.

arrangements.VOCAL: A repeating motif develops through dynamic contrast.
arrangements.RAP: Recurring rhyme shapes gain changing accents and emphasis.
arrangements.DANCE: Circular pathways open into straight, committed lines.

songs.name: Velvet Compass
songs.description: A quiet sense of direction survives a crowded night.

arrangements.VOCAL: A restrained verse gives way to a supported sustained hook.
arrangements.RAP: Low-key opening bars sharpen into a deliberate final statement.
arrangements.DANCE: Soft transitions frame clean stops and an assured finishing pose.

songs.name: First Current
songs.description: An uncertain first step finds momentum without losing its character.

arrangements.VOCAL: Short initial phrases join into a continuous melodic arc.
arrangements.RAP: Separated rhythmic figures connect into a steady extended flow.
arrangements.DANCE: Interrupted movements connect into an uninterrupted final phrase.

songs.name: Amber Minute
songs.description: One ordinary minute is held and made memorable through detail.

arrangements.VOCAL: Detailed articulation supports a direct and lyrical chorus.
arrangements.RAP: Concrete observations build into a sharply articulated refrain.
arrangements.DANCE: Small expressive details build toward a clearly framed final image.
